label: diffuse
phrase: no single life form clearly dominates the matched species core

label: tilted
phrase: one life form is somewhat more common but does not dominate strongly

label: concentrated
phrase: one life form dominates a clear majority of the matched species core

label: strongly_concentrated
phrase: one life form dominates almost all matched species

label: narrow
phrase: very few distinct life forms are represented in the matched species core

label: limited
phrase: only a limited set of life forms is represented

label: mixed
phrase: several distinct life forms coexist in the selected species core

label: broad
phrase: many distinct life forms are represented, so the structural profile is broad

label: mostly_nonfixed
phrase: most selected species do not resolve to a single life form

label: partly_fixed
phrase: only part of the selected species core resolves to a single life form

label: mostly_fixed
phrase: most selected species resolve to a single life form

label: strongly_fixed
phrase: almost all selected species resolve to a single life form

label: low_mixing
phrase: only a small part of the selected species core has mixed life-form assignments

label: present_mixing
phrase: mixed life-form assignments are present but not dominant

label: high_mixing
phrase: mixed life-form assignments affect a substantial part of the selected species core

label: dominant_mixing
phrase: mixed life-form assignments dominate the selected species core

label: near_complete
phrase: workbook coverage is nearly complete for the selected species core

label: partial_gap
phrase: a small but visible part of the selected species core has no workbook life-form match

label: notable_gap
phrase: a notable part of the selected species core has no workbook life-form match

label: high_gap
phrase: a large part of the selected species core has no workbook life-form match

label: low_compression
phrase: species-level differences are preserved because few species collapse into the same life-form buckets

label: mild_compression
phrase: some species-level detail collapses into repeated life-form buckets

label: strong_compression
phrase: many species collapse into a smaller number of repeated life-form buckets

label: very_strong_compression
phrase: the life-form view compresses many species into very few structural categories
